# idee-cli — Idempotent Dev Environment Engine

idee-cli is a Windows-native developer environment reconciliation tool with a companion telemetry dashboard.

## Core Concepts
- team-setup.json: Authoritative baseline specification committed to the team repo.
- local-override.json: Developer personal overrides stored in ~/.ideefy/local-override.json.
- Keyed Merge: Packages are merged by ID. Locked baseline fields cannot be overridden.
- Topological Execution: Kahn's DAG sorting resolves install order and hard-fails on cycles.
- Telemetry: Append-only telemetry engine tracking org-wide developer environment parity.
